import math

# Calculate 64 factorial
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)

# Print the factorial itself for verification
print(f"64! = {factorial_64}")

# Convert to string to get individual digits
factorial_str = str(factorial_64)

# Sum all the decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in factorial_str)

print(f"\nNumber of digits in 64!: {len(factorial_str)}")
print(f"Sum of all decimal digits: {digit_sum}")

EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Perfect! Let me verify the calculation:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /home/user/RSI && python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 64 factorial
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)

# Convert to string
factorial_str = str(factorial_64)

# Show the digits
print(f"64! = {factorial_str}")
print(f"\nDigits: {list(factorial_str)}")

# Calculate sum
digit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in factorial_str)
print(f"\nSum of digits: {digit_sum}")

# Double-check by manual calculation
manual_sum = 0
for digit in factorial_str:
    manual_sum += int(digit)
    
print(f"Verification: {manual_sum}")

EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Excellent! The calculation is complete and verified.
